page.title: Verify document integrity
page.subtitle: Upload a signed file or paste signed data to confirm who signed it and whether the content is untouched.

pdf.dropTitle: Choose or drop a PDF file here
pdf.dropHint: Supports standard PDF files up to 20 MB

jws.label: Signed data string
jws.placeholder: Paste the signed string or JSON content here...

codeLookup.title: Or look up by the code printed on the document

qrPage.title: Document record details
qrPage.subtitle: This code is registered in our records. To confirm your copy has not been altered, please upload the original file below.
qrPage.uploadSectionTitle: Upload the original file to verify content
qrPage.uploadSectionHint: Upload the PDF file or paste the digital record matching this code.
qrPage.mismatchAlert: Warning: The uploaded file belongs to a different document code and does not match the code you are viewing.

securityNotice.title: Important notice when scanning a QR code
securityNotice.body: This code only confirms the record exists in our system; it cannot prove your printed or local copy is untouched. Please upload the original file below to verify its content.

VALID.title: Document is intact
VALID.description: The signature is valid and the content matches the original signed version.

TAMPERED_CONTENT.title: Document was modified
TAMPERED_CONTENT.description: This content was changed after signing and should not be trusted.

CERT_REVOKED.title: Signature was revoked
CERT_REVOKED.description: The signing certificate was revoked before this document was signed.

CERT_EXPIRED_AT_SIGNING.title: Certificate expired before signing
CERT_EXPIRED_AT_SIGNING.description: The signing certificate was already expired when this document was signed.

UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE.title: Signature not recognized
UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE.description: This file does not contain a valid QuickSign signature or may be corrupted.

CODE_EXISTS_UNVERIFIED_CONTENT.title: Document code found
CODE_EXISTS_UNVERIFIED_CONTENT.description: The record exists in our system. Upload the original file to confirm its content is intact.

guards.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the 20 MB size limit.
guards.NOT_A_PDF: This file is not a valid PDF document.
guards.INVALID_JWS_FORMAT: The text is not in a valid signed data format.
